argument: The 27 leaves must read as one diagonal folded ledger before they read as a row of buttons. The broken spine, unequal gaps, hinge shadows, and open negative space must carry the composition without interface chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, status, caption, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v043's membrane, v044's radial aperture orbit, and v045's stratigraphic mass. It should read as a collective crease or folded score, not a decorative fan.

The viewer must make a phrase, not operate a parameter panel. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the deterministic cadence control must offer equivalent meaningful paths; no hover-only gesture may carry the work.
A single beat and a regular three-beat rhythm must remain geometry-neutral. Only an irregular interval ratio may alter actual fold, lean, height, opening, crease, and ink values across the ledger.

The tapped voice must not become a privileged source or remote receiver. An accepted cadence must implicate the entire chorus, with changes visible at both ends of the diagonal and through the central spine.
Early-break and late-break phrases must generate different crease geometry, not merely different labels. The distinction must persist in the folded planes and crease bars.
Four broken rhythms must compound in one ledger. Lift must reconstruct the exact preceding crease pattern and release must return to the deterministic quiet seed.
Generated WEBGL triangular leaves, hinge planes, spine, and crease bars are the medium. No screenshot, imported model, texture, SVG fallback, or decorative particle library may carry the work.

p5.brush is translated from programmable pressure and directional material production into an explicit inversion: pressure and duration are refused, while an uneven release cadence changes how the whole ledger is produced. No brush preset, watercolor, hatching, grain, source palette, source composition, source code, example, or API surface is reproduced.

v046 changes representation, composition, encounter, temporal behaviour, medium, and viewer task: the dense mass and remote response become a diagonal chorus of folded leaves whose archive is a broken rhythm shared by every voice.

Delete v046 if a single or regular phrase commits, the crease is cosmetic, only one voice changes, cadence shape is cosmetic, later rhythms reset, lifting is inexact, or the blind image reads as a fan, grid, orbit, membrane, or mass.
